==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I receive an angry email. The email contains an image of a humanoid lion with white fur and glowing red eyes. Underneath the image is the name "Asmodeus" in a shiny golden font.

I am pulled into the computer. I appear at a red bridge made of wood in a desert. The bridge is very unstable, but I manage to cross it.

I transform into a woman dressed in Arabian attire. I am in a small town in a country that is powered by belief. I don't know what I believe, which leaves me feeling unsure of my place here.
